title: Slow command logging: NNTP command timing and JMAP method timing
description: Wrap NNTP command dispatch with Instant::now()/elapsed(). If elapsed > threshold emit event=slow_command WARN with command, group, article_num/msgid, elapsed_ms, remote_ip. Wrap JMAP method dispatch similarly with event=slow_jmap_method, method, elapsed_ms. Blocked on: stoa-73bdf558.
